answer: Enrollment opens only at dawn and lasts one day. Each applicant locks 4,000 POA plus the prior day's net-issuance delta, and spends a single registrar-issued 32-byte cipher bound to one attested device. At the next dawn the registrar publishes a nullifier tape; any reused device or recycled cipher slashes every matching bond and voids those seats. Standing up 70 Sybil names therefore requires 70 attested devices and 70 distinct ciphers, with 70 × (4,000 + delta) POA frozen across two dawns—one collision burns the cluster.
